summary: Complete independent initial audit of all 195 Chinese units, 54 temporal/hint items, and 17 people. Eight extraction records in four source-backed groups need revision: two undated bibliographic labels were converted into personal activity, one historical allusion was expanded beyond its stated final-years range, one explicit AD 911 personal event was omitted from a hint, and one inconsistent ruler/era label was converted into AD 956 activity for Zhou Taizu. All other reviewed chronology and event ownership is supported by the cited Chinese chapter context.

findings.problem: The bibliographic labels 「薛史」 and 「歐陽史」 have been converted into AD 973/1053 personal activity despite containing no date or personal-event chronology.
findings.action: Remove those unsupported Western-year attestations and active-date hints. Preserve the source-work labels as undated references; do not infer living activity from them.

findings.problem: Han Gaozu’s active-date hint expands the chapter’s explicit 「末年」 reference (BC 196–195) into the unsupported whole-reign range BC 202–195.
findings.action: Replace the chapter-specific hint with BC 196–195, retaining the final-years source wording.

findings.problem: Tang Zhuangzong’s active-date hint omits his explicit AD 911 victory at Boxiang, treating the retrospective reign-title label as though activity began only in AD 924.
findings.action: Add the AD 911 personal event to the active-date hint while retaining the separately supported AD 924–925 records.

findings.problem: The extraction treats the internally inconsistent label 「周太祖顯德三年」 as AD 956 personal activity for Zhou Taizu, and propagates it into a 952–956 hint.
findings.action: Remove the AD 956 Zhou Taizu attestation and narrow the hint to the source-supported Guangshun 2 evidence. Preserve the Chinese source wording; do not silently rewrite the source or transfer the claim without a separately staged repair.
